scope: Diagnosis only. No source edits, weights, AutoModel, GPU calls, embeddings, build rerun, or partial-index modifications. Tokenizer imports did import torch transitively; no model was loaded.
input: First eight rows of build/p4/continuation-chunks-a-v1/chunks.jsonl, as configured batch_size=8; canonical text and passage-prefixed text with special tokens.

finding.cause: Transformers 5.12.1 AutoTokenizer chooses XLMRobertaTokenizer from tokenizer_config.json and reconstructs the backend rather than preserving the serialized pipeline. WhitespaceSplit is added before Metaspace, dropping the final space token ID 6 (U+2581). The raw normalizer Sequence(Precompiled, Replace regex ' {2,}' -> ' ') becomes only Precompiled. All other backend JSON fields compare equal, including vocabulary/model, added tokens and postprocessor. First-batch rows other than row 6 match in both modes.
finding.special_tokens: Postprocessor unchanged: single <s>:0 + A + </s>:2; no special-token-ID mismatch.
finding.source: Installed transformers/tokenization_utils_tokenizers.py:101-173 convert_to_native_format extracts vocab and Precompiled map for custom constructors; models/xlm_roberta/tokenization_xlm_roberta.py:81-104 reconstructs backend with WhitespaceSplit + Metaspace.

proposed_fix_not_applied: Load the verified frozen tokenizer.json through PreTrainedTokenizerFast.from_pretrained(local_directory, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False) instead of AutoTokenizer model-specific reconstruction. Verify full backend identity after disabling padding/truncation, retain checked_tokens ID equality and frozen inference counts. Do not strip chunk text, rewrite assets, change chunk boundaries, or bypass mismatch. This generic wrapper was tested in-memory: every serialized backend field equals the raw tokenizer, and model_input_names is exactly input_ids/attention_mask.

verification.generic_wrapper_first_batch: PASS checked_tokens for both passage: and query: prefixes; passage counts equal frozen rows.
verification.generic_wrapper_probes: PASS checked_tokens for both prefixes on 11 probes: trailing one/two spaces, tab, newline, leading space, NBSP, ideographic space, internal tab, literal special tokens, empty string, Japanese trailing space.
verification.recommended_regression_tests: Assert original AutoTokenizer reproduces ID-6 deletion on row 6 in current environment; generic wrapper exact backend equality; canonical and both-prefix full-ID equality; frozen token counts; BOS/EOS and padding IDs/masks; over-budget input rejection and deliberate ID-mismatch rejection. Include whitespace and literal-special-token probes. Before any future authorized inference, run a tokenizer-only full frozen-chunk parity/count scan and hash checks without regenerating chunks.
verification.not_performed: No full-corpus tokenizer scan, source modification, test-suite run, model load, or embedding build. Partial index build/p4/continuation-dense-a-v1 left untouched.
